task.title: Deliver Agora dashboard widget runtime to execute-plans (FE-DB-001 FE half)
task.summary_zh: 補交付 AG-FE-DB-001 缺失的前端半到 execute-plans repo(pantheon 側已標 done 但 FE 產物從未進 execute-plans)。依 SD §9.8 + design-closure A3(widget_registry.v1.json + widget_spec/chart_spec grammar)+ contract-closure 05(chart lib 決策)+ v1.3 workshop_card/widget schema,在 execute-plans 實作 src/agora/widgets/ 的 WidgetRegistry/WidgetRenderer/ChartSpecRenderer:首發只渲染 registry active widgets;ChartSpec 依 A3 grammar 對應 Recharts(metric/line/area/simple bar)+ ECharts(heatmap/network/sankey/candlestick/gauge/complex scatter);加 react-grid-layout 供拖拉。前後端 registry checksum 一致;agent 產出只能是宣告式 spec,前端不得 eval 任意 HTML/JS。package.json 加 echarts/echarts-for-react/react-grid-layout(+@types)。資料走 BFF client、頁面不得直接 fetch。 【UI 嚴格照設計稿,有疑問先 STOP】
acceptance: ChartSpecRenderer};只渲染 registry active widgets;ChartSpec 對應 Recharts/ECharts;react-grid-layout/echarts deps 入 package.json;無任意 code 注入;前後端 registry checksum 一致
task.next: Owner finalized: all widget artefacts verified in execute-plans (execute-plans HEAD merged into origin/dev), 17/17 tests pass. Delivery commit 6062cb2c under AG-FE-DB-001; Pantheon closeout PR #2178 merged into dev. Cross-repo tracking task closed.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：17/17 測試獨立驗證通過，所有驗收標準達成
